items.title: AMETEK (AME) Stock Looks Fully Priced On Its Indicor Deal
items.summary: AMETEK stock has delivered a strong 83.6% total return over the past five years, yet current checks suggest the shares are not a clear bargain. The 83.6% return over five years highlights that long term holders have already captured substantial value. This can make fresh upside harder to justify without stronger support...
